D: Two brothers coach rival kids' football teams in their small Ohio town.
P: Serve the snacks when the Little Giants run the big trick play.
S: Spiced beef and melted cheddar rolled tight in corn tortillas, baked until crisp like the ones on the counter roller, with salsa and sour cream. Brown 400g beef mince with a diced onion, 2 tsp taco seasoning and 3 tbsp water. Warm 12 corn tortillas so they bend. Spoon beef and 150g grated cheddar along each, roll tightly and lay seam side down on an oiled tray. Brush with oil and bake at 220C for 15 minutes until crisp. Serve with mild salsa and sour cream.
the big game against the Cowboys
Chicken wings baked at 220C for 45 minutes, tossed in a sticky honey and barbecue glaze, with ranch dip and celery.
Peanut butter balls dipped in dark chocolate with a round left showing on top, Ohio's famous treat.
M: Cincinnati-style beef chilli spiced with cumin, cinnamon and cocoa, ladled over spaghetti and piled high with grated cheddar and diced onion. Brown 600g beef mince with a diced onion. Add 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp cinnamon, 1 tbsp mild chilli powder, 2 tbsp cocoa, 400g diced tomatoes and 250ml water, and simmer 40 minutes until thick. Cook 400g spaghetti. Pile the spaghetti into bowls, ladle over the chilli and top with 200g grated cheddar and finely diced onion.
Becky the Icebox rallying the team

Macaroni baked in a cheddar and parmesan sauce with a hint of mustard, under a crunchy buttered breadcrumb crust, with a crisp green salad. Boil 400g macaroni for 2 minutes less than the packet says. Melt 50g butter, stir in 50g flour, whisk in 750ml milk and simmer until thick. Stir in 250g grated cheddar, 50g parmesan and 1 tsp mustard. Mix with the pasta and tip into a dish. Toss 60g breadcrumbs with 20g melted butter, scatter over and bake at 190C for 25 minutes. Serve with salad leaves.
W: the football the whole town is mad about
Chocolate cookie dough shaped into footballs, baked at 180C for 10 minutes, white icing laces piped across the top.
K: the water boys on the sideline

Fresh orange and lemon juice with a little honey and a pinch of salt, topped with icy water and served in paper cups with orange wedges. Squeeze 6 oranges and 2 lemons into a big jug. Stir in 2 tbsp honey dissolved in a little warm water and a small pinch of salt. Top with 1L cold water and plenty of ice and stir well. Pour into paper cups and serve with orange wedges for the players coming off the field.

s.note: the big game against the Cowboys
s.how: Toss 1kg chicken wings with salt and bake at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Warm 4 tbsp honey with 125ml barbecue sauce and toss the wings through. Mix sour cream with mayonnaise and herbs for a ranch dip, and serve with celery sticks.

Beat 250g smooth peanut butter with 60g soft butter and 2 cups icing sugar until it holds together. Roll into 24 balls and chill for 30 minutes. Dip each in 200g melted dark chocolate, leaving a round of peanut butter showing on top, then chill until set.

Cook 400g spaghetti. Pile the spaghetti into bowls, ladle over the chilli and top with 200g grated cheddar and finely diced onion.

w.note: the football the whole town is mad about
w.how: Cream 125g butter with 150g brown sugar, beat in an egg, then mix in 250g flour and 40g cocoa. Shape into small footballs and flatten slightly. Bake at 180C for 10 minutes and cool. Pipe white icing laces across the top with icing sugar and a little water.
